This fixture checks how links that point back into the same page are written. It also links to another page section on the same site.

First section

The first section has enough prose for Readability to keep it as part of the article body, plus a footnote reference[1] that targets the notes below.

Second section

The second section adds more steady paragraph text so the article extraction stays deterministic across browser runs.

[1] The footnote text lives on the same page as the reference.
